```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 9
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '9.0.x'

      - name: Install additional dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libc6-dev libgcc-11-dev libgdiplus

      - name: Initial Build
        run: |
          dotnet restore
          dotnet build -c Debug --no-restore
```
